dubai.name: DHA Registered Nurse
dubai.pass: 50% published threshold; reported as pass or fail
dubai.formatNote: DHA CBT guideline (Sep 2026) lists Registered Nurse as 150 questions, 3 hours, 50%. The 3 hours includes registration and introduction. Domain weights, breaks and block structure are not published in the sources reviewed.
dubai.warning: Domain weights are not published, so no official-style full mock is offered. Do not borrow weights from another regulator.

abudhabi.name: DOH Registered Nurse
abudhabi.fullName: Abu Dhabi Department of Health Registered Nurse
abudhabi.formatNote: A 2024 official DOH nursing licensing circular identifies Registered Nurse CBT as 150 MCQs over 3 hours. Domain weights and pass mark remain unverified; UAE PQR is a qualifications framework, not an exam blueprint.
abudhabi.warning: RN CBT count/time documented in a DOH 2024 circular. RN topic weightings and passing standard remain unconfirmed: no official-format mock is enabled.

RETAKE_NOTES.snle: SCFHS sources differ: the applicant guide describes up to four attempts a year, while the SCFHS dates page describes three attempts in an initial cycle with renewal provisions after a year. This is not a lifetime maximum. Confirm with SCFHS before relying on either.
RETAKE_NOTES.qatar: DHP policy (v04) and the qualifying-examination page describe five attempts. A three-attempt line sits under physician specialties and does not clearly apply to nurses. Effective dates are not stated; not confirmed in writing by DHP.
RETAKE_NOTES.dubai: General DHA licensing rules apply: three attempts across UAE authorities, a fourth only with permission, and a two-year block after the third failure before new attempts. Sources differ on details; confirm with DHA.
RETAKE_NOTES.abudhabi: UAE-wide rules allow three attempts across authorities, with a possible final attempt subject to approval. Confirm with DOH.
